tree.heading: Environmental law
tree.text: The term “environmental law” has the meaning given the term in article 24.1 of the USMCA.

tree.heading: Environmental obligations
tree.text: The term “environmental obligations” means obligations relating to the environment under—

children.text: chapter 1 of the USMCA (relating to initial provisions and general definitions); and
chapter 24 of the USMCA (relating to environment).

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This subchapter, referred to in text, was in the original “this title”, meaning title VIII of Pub. L. 116–113, Jan. 29, 2020, 134 Stat. 90, which is classified principally to this subchapter. For complete classification of title VIII to the Code, see Tables.
